title: Users and roles
intro: Manage staff accounts, PINs, role permissions, shifts, and tip-pool definitions that control who can access each screen and tab.

sections.title: User list
steps: Open the Users tab.
Browse active users with name, role, and contact fields.
Use Add user to create a new account or Edit to update an existing one.
sections.caption: Users maintenance table.

sections.title: Roles
sections.intro: Roles bundle permission modules that gate sidebar screens, Manage tabs, and protected actions.
steps: Switch to the Roles sub-tab under Users.
Create roles and open the module list to enable or disable access.
Assign roles to users so permissions stay consistent across staff.
sections.caption: Roles sub-tab.

sections.title: Shifts
sections.intro: Shifts define work windows used for labor reporting and automatic clock-out rules.
steps: Switch to the Shifts sub-tab.
Add shift names with start and end times.
Assign shifts to users for scheduling and tip-distribution context.
sections.caption: Shifts sub-tab.

sections.title: Tip definition
sections.intro: Tip definition sets pool weights and rules used when managers run tip distribution (see HR Guide → Tip distribution for payout runs).
steps: Switch to the Tip definition sub-tab.
Configure how tips are pooled and weighted by role or shift.
Save so tip distribution calculations use the latest rules.
sections.caption: Tip definition sub-tab.

sections.title: User form
sections.intro: POS operators log in with PIN or password and inherit role permissions.
steps: Open Admin → Users and add or edit.
Set login method, name, credentials, role, and shift.
Optionally create a linked HR employee record.
Save — user can sign in on terminals with assigned permissions.
sections.caption: User account form.

fields.name: First / last name
fields.effect: Displayed name on checks and reports.

fields.name: Password
fields.effect: Required when login method is password.

fields.name: User role
fields.effect: Permission bundle controlling modules and actions.

fields.name: User shift
fields.effect: Default work shift for labor reporting.

fields.name: Create employee
fields.effect: Auto-creates linked HR employee with employee number.

sections.title: Role form
sections.intro: Roles grant module and action access checked by protectAction throughout the app.
steps: Open Users → Roles.
Name the role and search the module tree.
Check parent modules or individual actions.
Save — assign the role on user records.
sections.caption: Role permissions editor.

fields.name: Module permissions
fields.effect: Hierarchical checkboxes for screens and sub-actions.

sections.title: Shift template form
sections.intro: Shifts in Admin → Users define named time windows for user default shift and schedule templates.
steps: Open Users → Shifts.
Enter name, start time, and end time.
Overnight shifts set ends_next_day automatically.
Save — selectable on users and HR schedule forms.
sections.caption: Shift template form.

fields.name: End time
fields.effect: Scheduled shift end; may roll to next calendar day.
